# Bounded invariant token with a nominal result

A public instance entry binds its sole nominally bounded method formal through
one complete invariant token, returning an independent fixed nominal type.
Frozen observers check receiver and token nulls, exact failures, partial state,
live cache changes during token callbacks, result identity and deferred uses.
Both dependency modes compare 64 JVM cases twice and retain all original
metadata, with Signature-only and independently compiled controls.
